summary: Iteration 49 – Postmortem (Nachanalyse) feature: full backend + frontend testing performed against the preview URL. All 8 pytest cases for the new /api/ai/postmortem/* endpoints pass (summary structure/values, mode split live/paper=6+6=12, per-trade detail, pending fallback for unknown id, empty context under n<8 overfitting guard, admin-only run with idempotence, regression on /api/health & /api/ai/status). The AIPostmortemPanel renders in the KI-Trader modal under the reward panel, shows correct summary '12 Trades ausgewertet', both setup rows 'breakout' and 'pullback' with 'sammelt (6/8)' badge, variant chips (pm-variants) open on click, pm-recent-table lists 12 rows, mode select 'nur Live' correctly filters to 6, pm-run-btn triggers the run and toast confirms '0 Trades, 0 Limit-Orders ausgewertet' (idempotent second run). No regression in KI-Trader learn area (AIRewardPanel renders fine).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be child of <option>. This originates from the Emergent visual-edit-overlay injecting a <span> inside the <option> element for the day-select in AIRewardPanel.js line 84. Not caused by app logic and does not affect functionality, but pollutes console. Consider not rendering the visual-edit source spans inside <option> tags.

critical_code_review_comments: Postmortem router + service look clean; robustness gates (n>=8, consistency>=0.6, gain>=0.15R, split-half) are correctly enforced and context_text() returns empty as designed for the seeded n=6 case (verified via /api/ai/postmortem/context).
Idempotency of POST /api/ai/postmortem/run verified – second run returns trades=0 as expected.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-existing seed data (seed-pm-0..11 + seed-pm-limit) from backend/tests/_seed_postmortem.py – no new seeding required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Postmortem endpoints under /api/ai/postmortem/{summary,trade/{id},context,run} and UI component AIPostmortemPanel are fully working. Seed data (12 trades, 1 limit) already reviewed. If trade_reviews collection is empty, re-run: python /app/backend/tests/_seed_postmortem.py && POST /api/ai/postmortem/run with admin token. The only observed console warning is a benign hydration warning from the visual-edit overlay on <option><span> in AIRewardPanel – not a real app bug.
